verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. Orama Cloud offers on-premise deployment of the context server on your own infrastructure, and Orama also ships as an open-source library you run in your own application. Either way the data stays under the user's control, which implies they govern retention themselves. Data sources can also be split by update schedule. Missing for 10: any documented delete/remove-document API, configurable retention policies or TTLs, Cloud-side data deletion or account purge guarantees, and independent corroboration.
